# Copilot Instructions for Navplan2

Purpose: Give AI coding agents the minimum project-specific context to be productive here without guesswork.

## Business Context
Navplan2 is a web-based flight planning application for VFR pilots in Switzerland, providing map-based route planning, weather, notams, aircraft w&b, aircraft performance, etc. The app serves recreational pilots, aiming to simplify pre-flight planning in the browser on a map with integrated charts, terrain data, and meteorological information, etc.

## Architecture Overview
- The application consists of three parts managed by Docker Compose: `navplan_persistence` (MariaDB), `navplan_backend` (PHP + Apache), `navplan_frontend` (Angular built and served by Nginx). See docker-compose for ports and volumes.
- Frontend calls REST endpoints exposed by Apache rewrite rules under `/api/...`, implemented in modular PHP domains (`Navplan/*`) wired via a DI container (`ProdNavplanDiContainer`).
- Each of the parts is primarily structured by business dommains, e.g.: Navaids, Airspaces, Airports, Routes, Flight Plans, Aircraft, Performance, Charts, Terrain, Meteo, etc.
- Each domain is structured into subfolders, depending on the required layers (e.g. backend: domain model, API entrypoint, service, repo; frontend: domain model, view, state, rest).
- Data flows: Angular → `environment.*.ts` base URL → Apache `.htaccess` routes → PHP domain services → MariaDB + file-based resources (charts, terrain, meteo). Static assets (charts, forecast tiles) mounted as volumes.

## Dev Workflow
- Start everything:
  - Build + run: `docker-compose build` then `docker-compose up -d`.
  - Frontend served at `http://localhost:4200`, backend at `http://localhost:8080`, DB at host port `3307`, phpMyAdmin at `http://localhost:8081`.
- Meteo forecast assets: copy local `navplan_backend/meteo_forecast` into the backend volume using `navplan_backend/copy_meteo_forecast.bat` (PowerShell/Windows). Container must be running.
- Logs: backend logs go to Docker stdout (see `php-app/config/navplan_prod.ini`: `log_file = php://stdout`); view with `docker logs navplan_backend`. Charts and meteo directories are persisted via volumes.
- Angular local dev: You can also run `ng serve` inside `navplan_frontend/angular-app` and point to backend `http://localhost:8080/` (already configured in `environment.ts`).

## Project Conventions
- Frontend layering per feature: `domain/` (models, interfaces), `rest/` (DTOs + converters + repos), `state/` (NgRx reducers/effects/actions), `view/` (`ng-components` for angular components and `ol-components` for OpenLayers). Example: Navaid feature in `src/app/navaid/*`.
- HTTP calls always go through feature-specific `Rest*Repo` services implementing `I*RepoService`, using `HttpHelper.mergeParameters` and `*Converter` classes for request/response typing.
- Map rendering uses OpenLayers; interaction/state lives in NgRx; styles in dedicated `ol-*-style.ts` files.
- Backend is structured by domains under `php-app/src/Navplan/*`, each with its own `Prod*DiContainer`. Apache `.htaccess` in `php-app/api` maps REST paths to domain entrypoints.
- Configuration comes from `php-app/config/navplan_prod.ini` via `IniFileConfig`; DB creds are supplied by Docker secrets, not hardcoded.

## Integration Points
- DB: MariaDB initialized from `navplan_persistence/db_init_scripts/*.sql`; user `tschanz_navfpl` granted RW on schema. Container exposes `3307` on host.
- Charts: served from `/var/www/html/charts` volume; frontend uses `environment.chartBaseUrl`.
- Terrain tiles: `/var/www/html/terraintiles`; backend Dockerfile fetches a small Swiss sample set at build time.
- Meteo forecast tiles: `/var/www/html/meteo_forecast`; copy provided dataset into the container for local usage.

## Examples to follow
- Frontend REST repo: `navaid/rest/service/rest-navaid.service.ts` shows URL param assembly and converter usage.
- Backend routing: `php-app/api/.htaccess` maps `/api/navaids` → `Navplan/Navaid/Navaid.php` via `RestServiceBootstrap.php` and DI wiring in `ProdNavplanDiContainer`.
- State management: `app.module.ts` bootstraps NgRx store/effects; see feature reducers/effects under `src/app/*/state/ngrx/`.

## Gotchas
- Angular CLI version in root README is outdated; Dockerfile installs latest CLI and builds to `dist/browser/` (Nginx serves static). Prefer Docker for consistent builds.
- CORS origin selection is handled in `RestServiceBootstrap.php` based on `HTTP_HOST` (localhost vs prod). Keep backend on `http://localhost:8080` to avoid CORS issues.
- Secrets files (`secrets/db_root_pw.txt`, `secrets/db_navplan_pw.txt`) must exist; Docker uses them to provision DB.

## Common tasks
- Add a new REST endpoint: update Apache rewrite in `php-app/api/.htaccess`, implement domain service under `php-app/src/Navplan/<Feature>`, wire via `Prod*DiContainer`, and add frontend `Rest*Repo` + NgRx actions/effects.
- Wire a map overlay: create `view/ol-components/*` for styling/interaction, connect to feature state, fetch data via the feature `Rest*Repo` using `environment.*` URLs.

- before every commit:
  - update these instructions when you notice missing context or useful information for AI coding assistants

## AI Longterm Braindump
- Backend DI: hybrid PHP-DI approach, migration now COMPLETE for all modules - there is no more `Prod<Feature>DiContainer` class anywhere in the codebase; every module (`Config`, `System`, `Persistence`, `Webcam`, `Navaid`, `Admin`, `Aerodrome`, `AerodromeChart`, `AerodromeCircuit`, `AerodromeReporting`, `Aircraft`, `Airspace`, `Exporter`, `Flightroute`, `Geoname`, `MetarTaf`, `MeteoForecast`, `MeteoGram`, `MeteoRadar`, `MeteoSma`, `Notam`, `OpenAip`, `Search`, `Terrain`, `Track`, `Traffic`, `User`, `VerticalMap`) ships a `<feature>.definitions.php` file, and `ProdNavplanDiContainer` loads ALL of them into ONE application-wide container and implements ALL `I<Feature>DiContainer` interfaces directly (one-line delegate methods; `getConfigDiContainer()` is the sole deliberate exception, see below). Each domain still keeps its explicit `I<Feature>DiContainer` interface as the module boundary. Key gotchas: (1) every module binds its controller to the shared `IRestController` interface - bind the CONCRETE controller class instead to avoid collisions once merged into one container; (2) historical only, no longer in the code: while the migration was in progress, each `I<Feature>DiContainer` interface was self-registered as `$this` in the container (`IXxxDiContainer::class => $this` in the constructor's definitions array) so any remaining not-yet-migrated module's factory closure doing `$c->get(IXxxDiContainer::class)->getYyy()` kept working; now that ALL modules are migrated, NOTHING does that lookup anymore (the `getXxxDiContainer()` facade methods return `$this` directly without touching the container) - the entire self-registration array was therefore deleted from the constructor; if a new not-yet-migrated module is ever added again, re-introduce this self-registration pattern (and watch for the no-recursion rule: delegate methods must target a DIFFERENT container key, never back to the own `I<Feature>DiContainer::class` key); (3) not every interface is worth flattening onto `ProdNavplanDiContainer` - `IConfigDiContainer` (extends ~10 narrow config interfaces, ~13 getters) stays un-flattened and is not implemented by `ProdNavplanDiContainer` at all (there is no more `ProdConfigDiContainer` wrapper class either - `IniFileConfig` implements `IConfigDiContainer` and all its narrow constituent interfaces directly, and `config.definitions.php` binds `IConfigDiContainer::class` straight to a `factory(fn() => new IniFileConfig(iniFilePath))`, since it needs zero flattening: no private Container, no factory-closure wiring, just a plain class); narrow config interfaces owned by other modules (`IMeteoForecastConfig`/`IMeteoRadarImagesConfig`/`IOpenAipConfig`/`ITerrainConfig`/`IAdsbexConfig`/`ITokenConfig`) get aliased in `config.definitions.php` via `get(IConfigDiContainer::class)` so their module's classes can autowire the narrow interface directly - but only if actually still consumed somewhere (e.g. `INotamConfig` was dropped entirely during the Notam migration since nothing type-hints it anymore); (4) "bridge" definitions (temporary `IXxx::class => function(c) { return $c->get(IYyyDiContainer::class)->getXxx(); }` entries) are only needed WHILE the owning module of `IXxx` is not yet migrated - all of these have now been deleted (last ones removed: `IUserService`/`ISearchUserPointUc` when `User` was migrated, `ITerrainService` when `Terrain` was migrated); if a new not-yet-migrated module is ever added again, re-introduce the same bridge pattern; (5) after each migration, grep production code (REST entrypoints in `<Feature>.php`, console scripts, other modules' constructors) for actual facade-getter usage and remove unused ones from both the interface and `ProdNavplanDiContainer` (underlying `*.definitions.php` bindings stay ONLY if still needed for internal autowiring, e.g. a controller/service autowiring a repo/query that has no external facade getter; if NOTHING type-hints an interface anymore, drop the binding entirely too); usage inside a module's own soon-to-be-deleted `Prod<Feature>DiContainerTest.php` does NOT count as "used" - e.g. the `Terrain`/`Track`/`Traffic` migration removed 9 getters this way (kept only `getTerrainService()`, `getTrackController()`, `getTrafficController()`, `getOgnListenerRepo()`), and the `User`/`VerticalMap` migration was even more drastic: `IUserDiContainer` shrank from 13 getters down to just `getUserController()`, and `IVerticalMapDiContainer` from 2 down to just `getVerticalMapController()` - all the UseCase/repo getters were only ever called from `ProdUserDiContainerTest`/individual UseCase unit tests via the (already-stale/broken, see below) `MockNavplanDiContainer`, never from production code; (6) when editing `ProdNavplanDiContainer.php` with multiple `replace_string_in_file` calls, NEVER batch them in parallel in one message - apply them one at a time and re-read/verify in between, since parallel edits to the same file can silently drop or duplicate changes; (7) also delete the now-orphaned `tests/unit/NavplanTest/<Feature>/Prod<Feature>DiContainerTest.php` for each migrated module - these tested the private-Container wiring of the removed `Prod<Feature>DiContainer` class and have no replacement (the merged container isn't unit-tested per module); (8) you can't easily smoke-test `ProdNavplanDiContainer` standalone outside Docker: `src/Autoloader.php` expects vendor at `src/vendor/autoload.php` (Docker layout) and the config ini path (`Config/config.definitions.php`, resolved relative to `src/Navplan/Config/../../config/...`) only works when the deployed layout differs from the raw checkout - workaround for a one-off manual smoke test: write a standalone script requiring `vendor/autoload.php` directly plus a small custom `spl_autoload_register` pointing at `src/`, and temporarily copy `config/navplan_prod.ini` to `src/config/navplan_prod.ini` (delete both afterwards!) to get past config loading; you'll still hit "Class mysqli not found" for any DB-touching getter since the local PHP CLI has no mysqli extension - that's expected/pre-existing and NOT a bug to fix; (9) `tests/unit/NavplanTest/MockNavplanDiContainer.php` (extends `ProdNavplanDiContainer`) is itself stale/out of sync with the real interfaces - it still defines orphaned overrides for getters that no longer exist on any interface (`getTerrainRepo`, `getAdsbexRepo`, `getOgnRepo`, `getTrafficDetailRepo`, `getUserRepo`, `getUserPointRepo`, ...) AND is missing methods that many User-UseCase unit tests actually call directly on it (`getLoginUc()`, `getTokenService()`, `getSearchUserPointUc()`, etc. - these tests were ALREADY broken/fatal-erroring before any of this DI migration work, unrelated pre-existing test-infra debt, out of scope to fix here); (10) `ProdConfigDiContainer` (the plain pass-through wrapper mentioned in older notes/docs) has been DELETED entirely - it added no value since `IniFileConfig` already implemented every narrow config interface `IConfigDiContainer` extends; if you see stale references to `ProdConfigDiContainer` anywhere (comments, docs), they mean `IniFileConfig`/`config.definitions.php` now. (11) `ProdNavplanDiContainer`'s class doc comment was rewritten to be a short, present-tense description of the current design only (no migration history/rationale) - do NOT re-add historical narrative there; the doc comment now explicitly instructs to keep removing unused getters (from both the interface and this class) and to delete an interface entirely once it has zero remaining methods. A full usage sweep across all 51 getters (production `<Feature>.php` entrypoints, `ConsoleBootstrap`/console scripts, other domains' constructors, and unit tests, via a `Search` subagent) found `getConfigDiContainer()` itself was ALSO unused (nothing ever called it - `IConfigDiContainer` consumers get its narrow interfaces via direct autowiring instead) - it and its `use Navplan\Config\IConfigDiContainer;` import were deleted; 16 further unused getters were removed the same way: `getWebcamByIcaoQuery`, `getNavaidService`, `getAirportService`, `getAerodromeReportingByPositionQuery`, `getAerodromeReportingByTextQuery`, `getAirspaceService`, `getFirService`, `getExportService`, `getGeonameService`, `getMeteoForecastVerticalCloudRepo`, `getMeteoForecastVerticalWindRepo`, `getNotamSearchByPositionQuery`, `getMailService`, `getProcService`, `getImageService`, `getCurlService` - removing `getGeonameService`/`getTerrainService`(already gone) left `IGeonameDiContainer` and `ITerrainDiContainer` with zero methods, so both interface files were deleted outright (and removed from `ProdNavplanDiContainer`'s `implements` list/imports); in every case the underlying `*.definitions.php` binding for the corresponding service interface (e.g. `IAirspaceService`, `IGeonameService`, `ITerrainService`, `IMailService`, ...) was verified via grep to still be consumed by direct constructor autowiring elsewhere and therefore intentionally left untouched - only the dead facade getter (and its interface declaration) was removed, never the DI binding itself. See `navplan_backend/php-app/docs/di-approach.md` for the (now historical, migration-complete) mechanical recipe; that doc was NOT updated as part of this cleanup and may still mention removed getters/interfaces. (12) `getHttpService()` was ALSO removed from `ISystemDiContainer`/`ProdNavplanDiContainer` (and the `IHttpService` import) in a follow-up pass: an initial grep for `->getHttpService(` looked like it found real usages in `UserServiceProcessorTest.php`/`SearchServiceProcessorTest.php`, but those are calls to a private test-local helper method of the SAME name (`private function getHttpService(): MockHttpService`/`?MockHttpService`) defined in those test classes themselves - completely unrelated to the DI container facade. Lesson: when grepping `->getXxx(` to decide if a facade getter is "used", always open the call site and check what `$this`/the receiver actually is - a same-named local method/variable can produce a false positive that looks identical in a plain text grep.
